messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT BOT: PagerDuty trigger -> high-inference-latency service:redwood-inference/replica-group-3 P2. Alert id: pd-78341. Auto-assign to maya oncall.
maya oncall: Acked — jumping in. Can someone post customer impact? which routes?
sam infra: Seeing a spike in p95 for /v1/generate on rg-3 in us-west1. Error rates flat, latency up ~3x for sequences >1024.
elaine observability: Confirmed on dashboards: inference.latency.p95 service=replica-group-3 prd showed 1200ms -> 3800ms starting 02:04 UTC. p50 stayed ~450ms.
paul sres: Noting autoscaler didn't spin up additional GPUs — group at 80% utilization but no scale event. Investigating controller logs.
carla product: Any customer-facing errors? CS reporting a slow ML sync for customer "AcmePay" but no 5xx.
maya oncall: No 5xx, just higher end-to-end times. Customer impact: interactive UX degraded for long prompts, possible timeouts in our client at 6s.
ops-bot: RUNBOOK STEP 1: If latency spike without errors, check kv-cache hit rates and batching behaviour. Run: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=15m | grep KVCache`
sam infra: KV cache hit rate dropped from 88% -> 32% for group-3. Looks like cache key mismatch after a model rollout earlier.
elaine observability: Adding a temporary dashboard panel for kv_cache.hit_ratio and batch_size distribution. Link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/alerts/rg3-latency (created)
paul sres: I see rollout marker: model v2.1 -> v2.2 at 01:58 UTC. v2.2 changed tokenizer tokenization spacing -> cache prefix mismatch plausible.
maya oncall: Ok, mitigation plan: 1) Silence noisy latency alerts for rg-3 to avoid alert storm, 2) Revert rollout to v2.1 on rg-3, 3) Validate KV cache rebuild.
carla product: +1 on revert if it reduces customer impact quickly. Need a postmortem note about canary gating for tokenization changes.
ops-bot: ACTION: creating maintenance window and silence rule. Executing: `alerts silence create --scope=rg-3 --duration=60m --reason="kv-cache mismatch post-rollout"`
alert-bot: alert-silence: created silence id s-9982 for 60m. Applies to alerts: inference.latency.p95, inference.batch_delay.high.
paul sres: Rolling back rg-3 to v2.1 now. Command: `deploy rollback --group=rg-3 --to=sha@v2.1` (kicking off)
sam infra: While rollback runs, we can temporarily lower the p95 threshold to reduce noisy pages but keep monitoring. Proposed change: p95 > 1500ms -> 3500ms for rg-3 for 1h.
elaine observability: I pushed a threshold patch to staging rules: 
```
- alert: InferenceHighP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, group))
  for: 1m
  labels:
    group: rg-3
  threshold: 3500
```
Please review.
maya oncall: Approved. Apply to production but keep 15m alerting window until we verify rollback effect.
ops-bot: applied threshold update (rule id r-4521) and created silence s-9982. Notifying monitoring channel.
paul sres: Rollback complete at 02:24 UTC. Scaling normalizing now. KV cache rebuilds in progress — hit rate climbing: 32% -> 71% over 8m.
carla product: Customer CS notified. Will follow up with AcmePay case owner with ETA.
sam infra: Observability: p95 trending back toward 700ms. No new pages.
elaine observability: Removing temporary dashboard once stable; will commit a permanent panel for tokenization-rollout metrics and add gating.
maya oncall: Thanks team. Post-incident tasks: 1) remove silence s-9982 after validation, 2) add alert suppression rule during canary tokenization changes, 3) update rollout checklist to include kv-cache key compatibility test, 4) run a thresholds audit to ensure thresholds are appropriate across groups.
carla product: I'll own the rollout checklist update.
paul sres: I'll create an eng-task to add a canary gate for tokenizer changes and schedule a retro.
elaine observability: I'll run a thresholds audit script and post results here. Quick snippet: `python tools/alert_audit.py --service=inference --output=ci/thresholds-rg3.csv`
ops-bot: NOTE: silence s-9982 will auto-expire at 03:24 UTC. If you want to clear it earlier: `alerts silence delete s-9982`
maya oncall: Leaving handoff notes for next oncall: rollback done, KV cache rebuilding, temporary thresholds applied, silence active until 03:24 UTC.
carla product: :thumbsup: thanks all, will track follow-ups in product/rollouts board.
elaine observability: Posting follow-up checklist and PR links once thresholds audit completes.
paul sres: closing timeline — incident resolved, no customer 5xx, mitigations reverted to baseline. Will open postmortem doc.
ops-bot: INCIDENT BOT: Incident resolved. Creating incident record id INC-2026-042.
maya oncall: handoff complete. Good run.
